svg.text: Prototype wiring 2 of 2: the modules, pin by pin
Each wire is labelled with where its other end goes. Pi numbers are header pins (page 1).
Twist H and L. DB9 pin 6 (second ground) optional.
off on a machine, on for the bench bus
Front end, one per probe (×4). R1: metal film, measured.
KY-040 module: CLK = A, DT = B, SW = push,
GND to the rail, + to the 3.3 V rail (never 5 V).
CAN monitors (dashed): 100k/10k dividers, only once clamps are fitted.
3.3 V rail: ADS1115 VDD, KY-040 +, CAN 3V3 if needed
ground rail: every module, the buttons, the encoder
Not on the rails: the display keeps its own lead to pins 4 and 6; the Picos are on USB. Electrolytic: stripe to ground.
